gloss: to distinguish by ear; to listen to reason

definitions.gloss: to distinguish by ear; to tell apart by listening
definitions.explanation: To tell sounds, voices, or words apart by listening carefully. A compound of {聞|き}く (to listen) and {分|わ}ける (to separate).

definitions.gloss: to listen to reason; to be sensible; to understand and accept
definitions.explanation: To hear an explanation and accept it — to be reasonable rather than stubborn. Often said of children who behave when things are explained to them.

examples.japanese: {音|おと}で{楽器|がっき}を{聞|き}き{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: To tell instruments apart by their sound.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{足音|あしおと}で{子供|こども}を{聞|き}き{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: My mother can tell which of her children it is just from the footsteps.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}の{声|こえ}を{電話|でんわ}{越|ご}しに{聞|き}き{分|わ}けるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to tell the twins' voices apart over the phone.

examples.japanese: よく{言|い}い{聞|き}かせると、{子供|こども}は{素直|すなお}に{聞|き}き{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: When I explained it carefully, the child understood and did as told.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はなかなか{道理|どうり}を{聞|き}き{分|わ}けない。
examples.english: He is quite unwilling to listen to reason.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{説明|せつめい}して、やっと{彼|かれ}は{事情|じじょう}を{聞|き}き{分|わ}けてくれた。
examples.english: After I explained it many times, he finally understood and accepted the situation.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Compound verb: {聞|き}く + {分|わ}ける.

SENSE NOTE: Sense 1 is literal — telling sounds or voices apart by ear. Sense 2 is figurative — hearing an explanation and accepting it. The related noun {聞|き}き{分|わ}け appears in {聞|き}き{分|わ}けのいい{子|こ} (a well-behaved, reasonable child).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音|おと}を{聞|き}き{分|わ}ける: to distinguish sounds
- {声|こえ}を{聞|き}き{分|わ}ける: to tell voices apart
- {道理|どうり}を{聞|き}き{分|わ}ける: to listen to reason

RELATED:
- {見分|みわ}ける: to tell apart by sight
